atoms.statement: Replace the current Test-IsLargeTask heuristic with a scope profile using acceptance_count, subsystem_count, and intent.estimated_turns, keeping the atom/decomposed-child early-return.
atoms.test: Test-IsLargeTask returns true for short-text/high-acceptance ideas and false for atom-tagged tasks.

atoms.statement: Reuse Add-ProjectBacklogFromMarker(Channel='main') as the single atom-ingest path for bridge-self decomposition, emitting [[PROJECT_BACKLOG]] JSON instead of raw Add-Idea.
atoms.test: Verify Add-ProjectBacklogFromMarker is called with Channel='main' and [[PROJECT_BACKLOG]] JSON is emitted for large main tasks.

atoms.statement: Decomposition must be mandatory: if a large bridge-self parent lacks a valid split, the driver forces decompose-retry and blocks STATUS: CONTINUE to coder.
atoms.test: Verify a large main task with no valid split does not dispatch coder, and after retry cap, it is held for operator review.

atoms.statement: Children of an approved decomposed parent must be created as approved, tagged as bridge-self atoms, and linked to the parent via source_task_id, bypassing approval/control-plane gates.
atoms.test: Verify children are created as approved, tagged bridge-self, and linked to the parent, without re-sticking on approval gates.

atoms.statement: The entire decomposition mechanism must be fenced to channel=='main'/scope=='bridge'; PROJECT channels must remain untouched, keeping Start-ProjectAutopilotIfNeeded and F1-F4 approval unchanged.
atoms.test: Verify a large PROJECT-channel task still requires F1-F4 approval and does NOT auto-split.

atoms.statement: A 'valid split' must be defined deterministically by the ingest return value (created>=2, errors empty, and each created atom has exactly one target file, concrete acceptance/checks, and parent linkage), not by re-scanning tags.
atoms.test: Verify parent closes only when ingest reports >=2 single-file approved atoms with acceptance/checks and parent linkage.

atoms.statement: Implement bounded decompose-retry (e.g., 2-3 attempts), feeding deterministic ingest errors back into the retry prompt, then transition to operator-hold; never fall back to coding the monolith.
atoms.test: Verify decompose-retry is capped (e.g., 3 attempts) and on exhaustion, the parent task is set to 'held' for operator review.

atoms.statement: Consolidate to one largeness function, one ingest path, one gate site, and reuse the existing [[DECOMPOSED]] handler, deprecating/redirecting the Add-Idea(status='new') child path, and introducing no new goals.md or parallel approval gates.
atoms.test: Verify there is only one largeness function, one ingest path, one gate site, and no new policy documents or approval gates are added.

atoms.statement: Planner output for a large bridge-self parent must contain both [[PROJECT_BACKLOG]] JSON (with required atom metadata) and [[DECOMPOSED:N]] markers.
atoms.test: Verify the planner prompt for a large main task instructs it to emit [[PROJECT_BACKLOG]] JSON with required schema and [[DECOMPOSED:N]] markers.

atoms.statement: The operator must review the MAP/PLAN and the list of atoms before they are auto-approved and dispatched to the coder.
atoms.test: Verify an explicit operator review step for the decomposed MAP/PLAN and atom list exists before auto-approval.

atoms.statement: Mandatory regression tests for PROJECT channels must be added to ensure non-interference.
atoms.test: Verify new regression tests are added to cover PROJECT channel non-interference and F1-F4 behavior.
